channel.title: O(1) Lab Research
channel.description: Papers, protocol work, engineering studies and negative results from O(1) Lab.

item.title: FROST-GKR: a global trace protocol for batched Poseidon2b
item.description: A three-column committed trace reduces an entire batch of Poseidon2b executions with two constraint sumchecks.

item.title: B64 and B255: choosing proof classes from measured cadence
item.description: Why two authenticated matrix classes were enough, and why a third class was rejected after measurement rather than intuition.

item.title: Treating soundness as executable protocol data
item.description: A security floor should move when the protocol moves. The ledger turns batching, Fiat–Shamir and QROM terms into checked inputs rather than prose copied between documents.

item.title: Proof-carrying State: synchronization without execution replay
item.description: Permanent headers, one recursive boundary terminal and exact live State replace historical transaction execution during bootstrap.

item.title: Binary-field kernels across PCLMUL, VPCLMUL, AVX-512 and PMULL
item.description: One fixed proof layout, several runtime-selected execution backends, and a 5.4× Poseidon2b batch-hashing result on AVX2 with VPCLMULQDQ.

item.title: The 30 GB wall and the single global walk
item.description: Per-family recursive replay was algebraically clean and operationally impossible. A heterogeneous union reduced nine family types to one walk and one channel schedule.

item.title: Closing the recursive verifier at a real fixed point
item.description: A link proof verifies a predecessor of its own class, with the complete verifier replay hosted at a 2^23 field shape.

item.title: From duplicated wallet proofs to owner-batched authorization
item.description: Public transaction logic moved out of the wallet proof; many inputs owned by one secret became one witness-hiding authorization capsule.

item.title: Binding a compact FRI opening back to its committed source
item.description: Transcript binding was not source binding. Query-level authentication closed a commit-to-A, open-from-A′ attack in the mixed-opening path.

item.title: A PCS implementation trail through a binary proof stack
item.description: Ladder-batched FRI, interleaved FRI-Binius and in-trace BaseFold were not interchangeable upgrades; each solved a different boundary.
